narrative.intro: National Technology and Engineering Solutions of Sandia obligated $633M in FY2027 to date. National Technology and Engineering Solutions of Sandia recorded 1 award this fiscal year, with an average award size of $633M. National Technology and Engineering Solutions of Sandia obligations are down 88.3% year over year. National Technology and Engineering Solutions of Sandia fiscal-year obligations were $4.3B in FY22, $4.7B in FY23, $5B in FY24, $5.7B in FY25, $5.4B in FY26, and $633M in FY27. National Technology and Engineering Solutions of Sandia current-year totals are partial (fiscal year to date). National Technology and Engineering Solutions of Sandia figures shown are contract obligations except award-value figures in the largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables, which are total contract values. National Technology and Engineering Solutions of Sandia reported a much smaller obligation level in FY27 compared with the prior five fiscal years. National Technology and Engineering Solutions of Sandia continues to show large historical contract volume followed by a sharply lower obligation level in the current partial year.

sections.body: National Technology and Engineering Solutions of Sandia obligations rose from $4.3B in FY22 to $5.7B in FY25, then declined to $5.4B in FY26 and to $633M in FY27.
